## 5. Reinstatement  
[ Swamy's -  
FR & SR, Part-I and CCS (CCA) Rules]  
1. Circumstances of reinstatement in service of an official after suspension/ compulsory retirement/ removal/ dismissal-
2. (a) If detention in Police custody, erroneous or without basis, ends in release without prosecution, deemed suspension ceases.
